name: Eidolon
description: The spectral embodiment of the lost identity of a Returned, without agency and never reunited with it.

description_citations.text: "The Nature of Identity" by Wizards of the Coast. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2014.

timeline.summary: Samia asks about the Returned and eidolons, and Perisophia explains that they lack the capacity for an identity.
timeline.quote: It would appear that the Returned and the eidolons lack the capacity for an identity.

citation.text: "The Nature of Identity" by Wizards of the Coast. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2014.
